missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Начальник' stays in the nominative as the subject of the sentence. 'Мой' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'занят' is the short-form predicate adjective. A clean introduction.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative equals genitive. 'Начальника' takes the -а ending because the noun is animate masculine, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Своего' agrees in the animate masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Начальника' is the genitive showing whose office it is. 'Нашего' is the agreeing masculine genitive. A core possession pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative indirect object. 'Начальнику' is the dative recipient of the report. The verb 'показал' takes a dative person, and 'отчёт' is the accusative thing shown.

missions.phrase: Я говорил с начальником о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Начальником' is the instrumental after the preposition 'с', meaning together with. 'О работе' adds the prepositional topic of the talk.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Начальнике' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A natural office-gossip frame.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Начальника' follows 'у' in the genitive to express possession. 'Новая машина' is the nominative thing possessed. The standard 'у кого есть' pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Начальники' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'были'. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'на совещании' gives the prepositional location.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural equals genitive. 'Начальников' takes the genitive-plural -ов ending, which serves as the accusative because the noun is animate. 'Своих' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate noun. 'Начальник' is nominative as the predicate. 'Строгий' and 'справедливый' are agreeing masculine adjectives describing his style, joined by 'но'.
